name: otp-infrastructure-service
description: Provider-independent OTP authentication backend with Firebase identity preservation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @otp-infra/contracts && npm run build -w @otp-infra/functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @otp-infra/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @otp-infra/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @otp-infra/functions
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-otp-infrastructure-service "vitest run --config vitest.integration.mts"
